verdict.summary: Issue #211 is blocked. The current exact version preserves owner history and accurately records that implementation cannot begin, but it remains a request for authenticated owner decisions rather than an executable specification. Contributor comments and autofix records provide no authorization.

blockingFindings.title: Canonical backend and fallback authority remain undecided
blockingFindings.details: For marius-patrik/Andromeda#211 at version db7547c8b51839093b00bcdf7eadda7cb905f76eb2d2d6b74383e34d44a9c8c7, Postgres and config projection remain alternatives. The authenticated owner must select the authoritative source, decide whether the other backend remains supported, and define exact fallback activation and write behavior that prevent split-brain, silent divergence, and automatic promotion.

blockingFindings.title: Single repository ownership and revision boundary are unspecified
blockingFindings.details: The issue does not identify the single owning child repository/gitlink, configured repository URL, exact admitted base revision, affected paths, feature-branch boundary, or whether the Andromeda umbrella gitlink update belongs to this lane. The submodule pointer contract is therefore unverifiable and work cannot be assigned to one accessible owner lane.

blockingFindings.title: Scope and dependency boundaries are unresolved
blockingFindings.details: Owner-approved non-goals are absent. Issue #210 and issue #212 are both open, while #211 supplies neither an objective default-branch or release condition for completing #210 nor a definitive ownership split with #212 for active-role and switcher state. Naming, Switcher Connect behavior, deployment topology, credential management, and unrelated configuration remain exposed to overlap.

blockingFindings.title: Persistence, failure, and trust semantics are not executable
blockingFindings.details: The contract-review section lists required decisions but does not provide owner-approved schema and identity rules, atomicity and concurrency behavior, ordering and durability guarantees, restart semantics, disagreement and corruption handling, partial-migration behavior, or trust boundaries for credentials, configuration, stored data, logs, and errors. Objective implementation and acceptance remain impossible.

blockingFindings.title: Migration and rollout policy require owner authorization
blockingFindings.details: No authenticated owner policy governs existing registry/*.yaml installations, mixed-version deployments, cutover, canonical-backend unavailability, or rollback. The contract must authorize an idempotent migration with preflight validation, recoverable backup, integrity checks, compatibility handling, cutover verification, losslessness evidence, and rollback behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Required validation and delivery evidence are unspecified
blockingFindings.details: The issue does not select GATEWAY_PG_DSN, a container fixture, or both as the mandatory live-validation gate; identify authoritative child and umbrella validation commands; assign fixture ownership; enumerate required failure cases; or define exact delivered-revision and main-branch or release evidence. The independently owned Validate results are not required in this review context, but the specification's validation coverage remains unverifiable.

blockingFindings.title: Workflow label does not reflect the owner-blocked state
blockingFindings.details: Verified target data shows only the P1 label. Trusted policy provides df:ask-owner and df:reviewed. Because authenticated owner decisions remain unresolved, df:ask-owner is required and df:reviewed must remain absent until a clean medium-tier round and independent high-tier confirmation both succeed.

nonBlockingNotes: Owner decision required: select the canonical source of truth and state the authority and support status of the alternative backend.
Owner decision required: name the owning child repository, URL, admitted base revision, paths, branch boundary, and umbrella-pointer responsibility.
Owner decision required: approve non-goals and objective sequencing and ownership boundaries with issues #210 and #212.
Owner decision required: select the mandatory live-validation gate and approve migration, mixed-version, cutover, outage, and rollback policy.
The preserved owner-text history is present; contributor-authored comments and autofix proposals are evidence only and do not resolve these decisions.
